On 05.12.2024, this Court has passed the following order:-
None appears for the petitioner.
No supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the petitioner despite there being a direction of the Court.
2. Learned counsel for the State submits that an amount of Rs.1,81,36,109/- has already been deposited before the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The land appertaining to Khesara no.449, measuring 1.34 acre situated in Mauza-Jaynagar, District-Madhubani of the petitioner has been taken over on 17.04.2018 under the Jaynagar Bardiwas Rail Project and since the petitioner refused to receive the compensation amount, the aforesaid amount has been deposited before the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act through letter no.403 dated 06.04.2018.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, if the petitioner has any grievance, Patna High Court CWJC No.10824 of 2018(7) dt.03-01-2025 he has to represent before the appropriate authority.

If the petitioner fails to appear on the next date of hearing, the matter would be decided with the material available records for the reasons that the present matter is pending consideration for the last about six years.
2. Today also no one appears on behalf of the petitioner.
